verdict.rationale: Gitea is self-hostable on any server, OS, or Kubernetes environment, including a cheap VPS or on-prem hardware, with a choice of backing database. That means the operator decides where code and data physically reside. Community reports confirm self-hosted deployments in practice. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation framing self-hosting as a data-residency control, and any evidence of region selection for the managed offering.
